regimens.dose_text: Transdermal patch: Initial dose 4.6 mg/24 hours patch applied once daily to clean, intact skin. After a minimum of 4 weeks, increase to recommended maintenance dose of 9.5 mg/24 hours. May increase to 13.3 mg/24 hours in severe dementia. Rotate application sites daily (upper/lower back, upper arm, chest); do not apply to same site for 14 days. Transdermal formulation significantly reduces gastrointestinal adverse effects.
